passage: Octopuses in one laboratory learned to unscrew jar lids to reach crabs sealed inside, but individuals differed in how they did it. Some twisted the lid with a single arm; others braced the jar with several arms and turned the lid with the rest; one simply pried at the seal until it gave. Even animals that had watched a neighbor succeed went on to use a method of their own, working alone. Each animal's solution was, in this sense, ______, which complicates any attempt to describe a single octopus method for the task.
prompt: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
explanation: Every octopus settled on its own technique, even after watching others, so each solution was "distinctive." "Cultural" fails because watching a neighbor did not pass a method on, and "communal" fails because each animal worked alone. "Complex" fails because one animal simply pried at the seal; the text's point is variety, not intricacy.

deletion_test.kept_sentence: Each animal's solution was, in this sense, ______, which complicates any attempt to describe a single octopus method for the task.
deletion_test.why: alone, solutions that resist being described as one method could be distinctive to each animal, too complex to summarize, or shaped by local culture; only the earlier sentences show simple methods kept individually despite watching others
